notes: Companies House SC645290 (CHEMIFY LIMITED), a Scottish company incorporated 24 Oct 2019. The company says it was 'founded in 2022', i.e. its spin-out from the University of Glasgow in March 2022.

Accounts PDFs are scanned images; employee counts were read by OCR and checked against the category totals (79+32+11+5=127; 42+25+7+5=79). FY2025 are group accounts and include the subsidiary Chemify US Inc.

SH01 allotments: 14 Feb, 25 Feb, 11 Mar 2022 (seed); 27 Jan, 28 Feb, 5 May, 13 Jul 2023 (Series A); 26 and 29 Jan, 1 Apr, 18 Jun, 1 Oct 2024 and 7 Jan, 1 Jun 2025 (small, likely options or extensions); 23 Sep 2025 (Series B); 12 Dec 2025, 24 Feb 2026, 24 Jul 2026 (Series B1).

Disclosed equity about USD 93M+ (USD 43M cumulative to Aug 2023, USD 50M+ Series B); Sky News reported 'more than GBP 100m' from investors by Sep 2026, suggesting the unpriced Series B1 extension was material. A Series C of USD 250M-1B was reportedly being prepared (Dealroom, Sep 2026).
Grant USD figure converts GBP 22M at ~1.34 USD/GBP. The 2023 round also included the UK Government Innovation Accelerators programme (Glasgow City Region).
No OpenAlex institution record or works with a Chemify raw affiliation; staff publish under the University of Glasgow.

Current openings are listed on chemify.io/careers and hosted on PeopleHR (chemifyltd.peoplehr.net); 33 titles. Mapping: CADD and ML scientists -> ml-research; chemists and analytical/purification technicians and lab coordinator -> materials-science; mechanical, mechatronics, manufacturing, firmware engineers and automation scientist -> lab-automation; software, product owner/designer and CTO-office director -> software-eng; finance, H&S, project and operations managers -> business-ops.

Postings: 58 distinct PeopleHR posting IDs, merging 32 Wayback-captured IDs (first capture 2025-11-22) with 32 live IDs dated on the careers page (6 overlap); earliest date per ID wins. The board is not visible in Wayback before the Oct 2025 Series B, so earlier hiring is uncovered. 24 of 33 live titles were posted June-September 2026.
Aug 2024 About page also lists investors not named in the round announcements: Founders Fund, Berggruen Holdings, DCVC and Creator Fund.
